title: How to Join IIIT Hyderabad Without JEE Main: Complete UGEE Guide
meta_title: IIIT Hyderabad Admission Without JEE Main: UGEE Eligibility, Exam Pattern, Interview and Preparation
meta_description: Want to study at IIIT Hyderabad without JEE Main? Learn about UGEE, the exam pattern, selection process, dates, preparation strategy and other admission routes.
author: naacollege.in Editorial Team
excerpt: You do not need JEE Main to get into IIIT Hyderabad. The institute runs its own entrance test called UGEE. This guide explains the process step by step.
important_note: The dates and details below are based on the 2026 admission cycle. IIIT Hyderabad can change dates, fees, eligibility and pattern each year, so always confirm on the official admissions portal (ugadmissions.iiit.ac.in) before applying.

sections.heading: Introduction
paragraphs: International Institute of Information Technology Hyderabad, popularly called IIITH, is one of India's top institutes for computer science, electronics and research. Many students assume you must clear JEE Main to enter. That is not the only way.

IIIT Hyderabad conducts its own Undergraduate Entrance Examination (UGEE). Through this exam, students can join the five-year dual degree programmes that combine a B.Tech with an MS by Research, without depending on a JEE Main rank.

sections.heading: What Is UGEE?
paragraphs: UGEE stands for Undergraduate Entrance Examination. It is conducted by IIIT Hyderabad itself and is the main route into its research-oriented dual degree programmes.
In the 2026 cycle the exam was a computer-based test held on 2 May 2026 and lasted three hours, from 9:00 AM to 12:00 noon. It was followed by on-campus interviews in early June.

sections.heading: Admission Routes at IIIT Hyderabad
paragraphs: IIITH offers more than one way to apply for undergraduate programmes. Reports on the 2026 cycle mention several channels:
list: UGEE channel: IIITH's own entrance exam followed by an interview, the route this article focuses on
JEE Main channel: for students who prefer to use their JEE Main performance
DASA channel: for eligible international and foreign-based candidates
Olympiad channel: for eligible medallists in recognised olympiads
SPEC channel: a special channel with its own criteria
sections.note: Eligibility rules for each channel are different. Read the official brochure carefully.

sections.heading: Programmes You Can Join Through UGEE
paragraphs: UGEE leads to the five-year dual degree programmes in which students earn a B.Tech and an MS by Research. These programmes are built around research, so students work on real problems with faculty early in their studies.

Typical areas include computer science, electronics and communication, and interdisciplinary tracks such as computational and data-oriented fields. Check the current brochure for the exact list of programmes and seat availability.

sections.heading: Eligibility
paragraphs: Eligibility usually depends on your Class 12 or equivalent qualification and your subject background. Reports on the 2026 cycle say IIITH did not set a minimum or maximum age limit for UGEE applicants.
Because percentage requirements, subject combinations and board rules can change, confirm them on the official UGEE page for the year you are applying.

sections.heading: Important Dates (2026 Cycle as a Reference)
sections.note: Some third-party sites list slightly different closing dates. Treat the official IIITH admissions portal as the final source. Future cycles usually follow a similar timeline, so start preparing well before February.

sections.heading: UGEE Exam Pattern
paragraphs: The exam is reported to have two parts, SUPR and REAP. SUPR is a subject proficiency test, and REAP is a research aptitude test that checks reasoning and problem-solving ability.

Reports for 2026 also mention negative marking of 25 percent in both sections. That means wrong answers can reduce your score, so guessing blindly is risky. Confirm the latest marking scheme in the official information brochure.

sections.heading: Selection Process: Written Test and Interview
paragraphs: Clearing the written test only gets you shortlisted. IIITH then calls candidates for interviews on campus, and final selection depends on the interview stage.

The interview tests how you think, not just what you memorised. Expect questions on mathematics, logic, programming interest and projects you have done. Interviewers often like to see how you approach a problem you have not seen before.

sections.heading: How to Apply: Step by Step
steps: Visit the official IIITH undergraduate admissions portal and read the current brochure.
Check eligibility for the UGEE channel and any other channel you plan to use.
Create an account and fill in the application form with correct personal and academic details.
Upload the required documents and photographs as per the instructions.
Pay the application fee online. Reports note that female applicants pay a lower fee.
Submit the form before the deadline and save a copy of the confirmation.
Download the admit card when released and note the exam centre.
Appear for the exam, check the result, and prepare for the interview if shortlisted.

sections.heading: How to Prepare for UGEE
paragraphs: UGEE rewards strong fundamentals and clear thinking more than rote learning. Here is a practical preparation plan.
list: Build mathematics fundamentals: algebra, probability, combinatorics, sequences, geometry and calculus basics
Practise logical and analytical reasoning daily with puzzles and pattern questions
Solve previous years' papers and sample questions from the official site under timed conditions
Learn basic programming and problem solving, even if it is just Python or C
Practise accuracy because of negative marking; attempt questions you are reasonably sure about
Review mistakes in a notebook and revisit them every week
Work on small projects, such as a simple game or website, to speak about in the interview
Practise explaining your thinking aloud, since interviews value reasoning

rows: Revise Class 11 and 12 maths, learn basic programming
Reasoning practice, topic tests, official sample papers
Full-length timed mock tests and error analysis
Interview practice, project revision, light revision of weak areas

sections.heading: Common Mistakes to Avoid
list: Relying only on coaching notes and ignoring the official syllabus
Ignoring negative marking and guessing randomly
Missing the application deadline because of last-minute issues
Not preparing for the interview after clearing the written test
Trusting unofficial websites for dates and rules without checking the IIITH portal

sections.heading: Why Choose IIIT Hyderabad?
paragraphs: IIITH is known for its research culture, strong faculty, active labs and close ties with industry. Students get early exposure to research in areas such as machine learning, language technologies, robotics, security and more. Its location in Hyderabad's Gachibowli tech hub also helps with internships and networking.

faq.question: Can I get into IIIT Hyderabad without JEE Main?
faq.answer: Yes. IIITH conducts its own entrance exam, UGEE, followed by an interview. Other channels such as Olympiad also exist for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Is there an age limit for UGEE?
faq.answer: Reports on the 2026 cycle state that no minimum or maximum age limit was set. Confirm in the current brochure.

faq.question: Is there negative marking?
faq.answer: Reports for 2026 mention 25 percent negative marking in both sections. Check the official instructions for the latest rule.

faq.question: Is the interview compulsory?
faq.answer: Yes, shortlisted candidates are called for interviews and final selection depends on them.

faq.question: When should I start preparing?
faq.answer: Ideally at least six months to a year before the exam, so you can cover maths, reasoning and basic programming comfortably.

conclusion: JEE Main is not the only door to IIIT Hyderabad. With strong fundamentals, steady practice and a curious mind, UGEE can take you into one of the country's best research-focused undergraduate programmes. Start early, follow the official website, and prepare for the interview as seriously as the written test.
disclaimer: Information is based on publicly reported details of the 2026 admission cycle and may change. naacollege.in is not affiliated with IIIT Hyderabad. Verify everything on the official website.
